posts.cooked:
The heroes and villains with static heights do actually have their heights specified in their various bios.

But Akash of the Many Names was called out by Christopher as being able to change her size as she pleases (or as comic artistic license requires), and the other folks you call out also are listed in their bios as having shapeshifting capabilities of some stripe (except for Scholar; not sure about him).

posts.cooked:
No problem. :3

It's pretty fun to consider the height differences, anyway.

Like in the F5, we have:

AZ at 5'7"

Wraith at 5'7"

Bunker at 5'8"

Tachyon at 6'

Legacy at 6'2"

I wouldn't have expected Tyler to be a bit short for a guy somehow.

For the Prime Wardens:

Tempest at 5'2"

Captain Cosmic at 5'9"

Argent Adept at 5'10"

Fanatic at 5'10"

Haka at 7'2"

Poor tiny little Tempest. Also I feel like I would have expected Fanatic to be taller... it's the forceful personality.

And finally the Dark Watch.

Mr. Fixer: 5'7"

Nightmist: 5'7"

Setback: 5'11"

Expatriette: 6'1"

Fixer is a Pint-Sized Powerhouse.

The weights are interesting, too. You get an idea of stuff like how skinny Argent is compared to the other fellas, or how it makes sense that Parse's portrait in the digital version was changed to being a bit chubby.

Well, again, I already explained my own frame of reference/thinking, so I'll just point people back at it.

And, here's a list of every hero grouped by height:

  • 5'1": Visionary
  • 5'2": Tempest
  • 5'4": Unity
  • 5'5": Parse
  • 5'7": Absolute Zero, Mr. Fixer, Nightmist, Wraith
  • 5'8": Bunker, Medico
  • 5'9": Captain Cosmic, Scholar
  • 5'10": Argent Adept, Beacon, Fanatic
  • 5'11": Chrono-Ranger, KNYFE, Ra (as Blake, 6'4" as Ra), Setback
  • 6': Tachyon
  • 6'1": Expatriette, GI Bunker, Grandpa Legacy, Naturalist
  • 6'2": Legacy
  • 6'5": Mainstay, Sky-Scraper
  • 7'2": Haka
  • 8'6": Fright Bunker
 
Honorable mentions go to Idealist who is 5'3" but still a growing kid, Omnitron-X who is 5' but a robot, and Guise and Writhe who are 5'10" and 5'5" respectively but also described as explicitly having varying heights.
